messages:
samir: ACME escalated - tool call to generate_report returns 400. They see 'Unexpected token "%"' when passing report_id. Pasting their repro.
priya: paste it pls
samir: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call_tool \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{
  "model":"redwood-chat-1",
  "tool":"generate_report",
  "tool_args": { report_id: %5E2024-ACME%7C42, format: csv }
}'
```
priya: ah i see - their tool_args object has unquoted keys/values and a percent sign not in quotes.
tasha: can you include the exact API error body from our logs?
samir: from proxy logs:
```
remote_addr=1.2.3.4 method=POST path=/v1/call_tool status=400 error="ToolArgsParseError: Unexpected token '%' at 27" duration_ms=12
stack=SyntaxError: Unexpected token % in JSON at position 27
    at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
    at parseToolArgs (/srv/runtime/parser.js:132:21)
```
morgan: probable client bug: their frontend does encodeURIComponent(reportId) but then passes the object to our REST call without JSON.stringify in their environment, causing some clients to send raw tokens. Repro steps below.
priya: customer says they used our JS SDK v1.2.3. Is there an SDK bug?
morgan: yes - SDK v1.2.x had a regression where objects with URL-escaped values were serialized incorrectly when chunked. Patch landed in v1.2.4. Recommend they upgrade.
priya: workaround for now: ensure report_id is a string literal (wrap with quotes) or call JSON.stringify on tool_args before passing. e.g.
```js
// workaround
await client.callTool({
  model: "redwood-chat-1",
  tool: "generate_report",
  tool_args: JSON.stringify({ report_id: reportId, format: 'csv' })
})
```
morgan: i'll add a defensive server-side validation to return a clearer error: "tool_args must be valid JSON; if you pass a JS object ensure it's serialized."
deploy-bot: deploy queued for 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC - patch: improve-toolargs-error-msg
samir: shared workaround with Acme, they confirmed upgrade to SDK v1.2.4 fixed it. closing once Morgan confirms server message patch.
morgan: rolled out improved error message to staging, will prod-deploy tonight. closing loop.
samir: thanks :thumbsup:
